title: Magnetic inclination records latitude
caption: In a dipole field the dip of the field lines depends on latitude: tan I = 2 tan λ. A lava that froze in a 30° inclination formed at λ = tan⁻¹(tan 30°/2) ≈ 16°, so the rock has moved if it now lies elsewhere.
alt: Magnetic inclination against latitude, rising from zero at the equator to 90 degrees at the pole, with 30 degrees of inclination at 16 degrees of latitude marked.
description: tan I = 2 tan λ: horizontal field at the equator (I = 0), vertical at the poles (I = 90°).
Rocks of different ages from one continent give different latitudes: evidence of drift.
